# Introduction 

## scatterhist
```{r}
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(100, mean = 50, sd = 10)
y <- x + rnorm(100, mean = 0, sd = 5)

scatterhist(x, y, xlab = "Random X", ylab = "Random Y")

```

## myncurve
```{r}
myncurve(mu = 10, sigma = 2, a = 12)

```

## myboot2
```{r}
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(20, mean = 5, sd = 2)
myboot2(x = x, fun = "mean")
```

## mymlnorn
```{r}
mymlnorm(x=c(0,12,13,15,12,11,10),mu=seq(5,15,length=1000),sig=seq(0.1,6,length=1000),lwd=2,labcex=1)
```
